content.text: In Zimbabwe, where conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-14|USDT Payment]] platforms like Stripe are restricted, digital creators face significant challenges in [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-19|setting]] up online stores that can accept payments seamlessly. This infrastructure gap is not unique to Zimbabwe; many countries face similar restrictions, hindering the growth of digital commerce. The absence of reliable payment processing systems forces creators to seek alternative [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/solutions-when-stripe-paypal-ban-account-explained-digital-4|COREMERCH guide to solutions]], often leading to cumbersome workarounds that lack the simplicity and security of integrated platforms.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The COREMERCH infrastructure, particularly Stack 01 and Stack 02, offers a robust solution for digital creators looking to establish a sovereign digital commerce presence. By leveraging GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, creators can build a fully operational online store. The integration with NOWPayments enables automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, allowing for the acceptance of over 300 cryptocurrencies with a minimal fee of 0.5% and no requirement for KYC or buyer accounts.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, it's essential to understand the differences between Stack 01 and Stack 02. Stack 01, which can be deployed in 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint, uses GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments, making it a straightforward and cost-effective solution for creators with basic needs. On the other hand, Stack 02, deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, utilizes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, offering a more comprehensive and scalable infrastructure suitable for creators with more complex requirements or a larger product catalog.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up the payment and delivery pipeline is crucial for a seamless customer experience. With NOWPayments, you can automatically verify crypto payments on-chain, ensuring that your store can process transactions efficiently. Additionally, configuring your store to deliver digital products instantly upon payment confirmation enhances customer satisfaction and reduces support queries. The use of Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery ensures that your products are securely stored and easily accessible to customers.
Deploying a digital store with crypto payment capabilities is now more accessible than ever with COREMERCH's Stack 01 and Stack 02.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up, going live and processing your first transaction is an exciting milestone. It's crucial to test your store thoroughly, ensuring that all components, from the frontend to the payment processing, are working as expected. The first transaction is not just a test of your infrastructure but also a validation of your product's market demand. With the right infrastructure in place, you can focus on marketing and selling your products, knowing that the technical aspects of your store are well-handled.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling your digital store requires careful planning and the right infrastructure. As your store grows, so does the need for a scalable and reliable backend. Stack 02, with its Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, is designed to handle increased traffic and larger product catalogs. By leveraging these technologies, you can ensure that your store remains performant under load, providing a consistent experience for your customers. Furthermore, the ability to process crypto payments without intermediaries gives you a competitive edge in the global market.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, you can utilize the COREMERCH Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack, depending on your needs. The Edge Commerce Stack, in particular, offers a comprehensive solution with Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, all deployed and end-to-end tested within 48 hours. This stack allows you to load up to 5 products, with SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured for enhanced email deliverability, and comes with 30-day support to ensure a smooth transition to your new infrastructure.
The Edge Commerce Stack offers a comprehensive infrastructure solution for digital creators, including deployment and testing within 48 hours.

For digital creators looking to host their stores on free platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages and accept crypto payments, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a viable option. This stack, deployed in 48 hours, includes everything needed for a fully operational digital store, including payment processing through NOWPayments. You can explore more about the Edge Commerce Stack and other products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, where you'll find detailed information on how to get started with your sovereign digital commerce journey.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your digital store, start by choosing between Stack 01 and Stack 02 based on your requirements. Next, set up your hosting on either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Then, configure your backend logic using Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. After that, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing and set up your product delivery pipeline using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, test your store thoroughly before going live, ensuring that all components are working as expected. For a more comprehensive solution, consider purchasing the Edge Commerce Stack, which includes deployment and testing within 48 hours.
